name: PocketMC Server Manager
description: Model Context Protocol interface for orchestrating local Minecraft server instances, reading telemetry, and managing server processes.

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description: List all configured Minecraft server instances with runtime metrics (status, memory, CPU, player count, active ports).

tools.name: start_instance
tools.description: Start an existing Minecraft server instance by its unique ID.

tools.name: stop_instance
tools.description: Gracefully stop a running server instance using RCON save-all flush.

force.description: Force kill if shutdown times out

tools.name: send_console_command
tools.description: Execute a command string directly into the server console.

tools.name: trigger_backup
tools.description: Trigger an immediate RCON-held world backup with cloud replication.

tools.name: get_tunnels
tools.description: Get active Playit.gg and Cloudflare tunnel public addresses for server instances.
